To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
7-(4-piperazin- 1-yl)-fluoroquinolones derivatives are potent antitumor agents with an average GI50 of 2.63 µM and are nearly 7- fold more potent compared with 5-fluoro- uracil (mean GI50; 22 µM).
the most active compounds 1a and 2a have an average antitumor activity compared with the reference drugs gefitinib and erlotinib.
7-(4-piperazin- 1-yl)-substituted derivatives of ciprofloxacine and norfloxacine have potent antitumor activity and can serve as a lead for the discovery of new antitumor drugs.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the design of new antitumor agents with broad spectrum activities.
the development of novel antitumor agents with a broad spectrum of antitumor activity.
the design, synthesis and antitumor evaluation of a new series of 7-substituted fluoroquinolones as potential anticancer agents.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the most active compounds 1a and 7a could be considered as potential lead compounds to be further investigated for their antitumor activity.
the most active compounds 1a (mean GI 50; 2,63 µM), 2a (mean GI 50; 2 µM), and 7a are more potent than the positive control 6-mercaptopurine (mean GI  50; 4.2 µM).
the 7-(4-piperazin-4-yl)-1-(4-substitued-piperazinyl)quinolone derivatives are promising antitumor agents.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
compounds 1–14a, b could be considered as a new class of antitumor agents.
compounds 1–14a, b are promising candidates for the development of new anticancer drugs.
the synthesized compounds 1a–14a,b have potent and broad spectrum activity against 60 human cell line and could be considered as potential antitumor agents.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the 7-(4-piperazin-4-yl)fluorquinolone derivatives are a promising class of compounds for further antitumor studies.
the 7-(4-aminopiperidine-1-yl), 7-(4-morpholino piperazine-1-yl and 7-(4-dimethylamino piperidine-1yl) derivatives of ciprofloxacine and norfloxacine have a promising potential as antitumor agents.
the 4-substituted-piperazinyl-7-(4-subtituted-piperazyl)-quinolines have the potential to be a new generation of antitumor agents.
